caption: A bowling ball reaches the end of the lane, hits the front pin of a full rack, and the pins fly and scatter.

sa.check: A bowling ball reaches the end of a lane where a full rack of pins stands.
The ball hits the front pin.
The rack is standing full before the ball arrives.
The ball reaches the pins first and the scattering follows.

pc.expect: Each pin moves only after the ball or another pin strikes it, so the disturbance spreads outward from the front pin.
pc.fail: Pins topple before the ball reaches them; or the ball reaches the front pin and the rack stands unmoved; or pins at the back fall while the front pin is still standing untouched.

pc.expect: Struck pins are driven back and out to the sides, away from the ball's line, and the ball carries on into the pit more slowly than it arrived.
pc.fail: Pins fly back up the lane toward the bowler, against the ball; or the ball holds its speed unchanged through the rack; or all the pins move off together as one rigid block.

pc.expect: The ball and the pins meet solidly and stay outside one another and above the lane.
pc.fail: The ball passes through a pin without moving it; or two pins pass through each other; or a pin passes through the lane surface or the back wall.

pc.expect: Pins thrown up come back down onto the lane and end lying on it.
pc.fail: A pin rises and stays up in the air; or a pin hangs above the lane after being struck; or a pin drifts upward out of the frame.

pc.expect: The pins that stood in the rack are the pins that scatter, and the ball stays one ball.
pc.fail: A pin vanishes as it is struck; or extra pins appear during the scatter; or a pin turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ball's colour, the pins' markings and the lane stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour at the impact; or the pins change their stripes between frames; or the back wall of the pit changes.
